title: Pasta Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Mix eggs, bacon, and Parmesan. Combine with cooked spaghetti. Add pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry chicken and vegetables. Add soy sauce, ginger, and garlic. Cook until chicken is done.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven. Mix flour, sugar, butter, chocolate chips, and vanilla extract. Form dough into cookies. Bake until golden brown.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella. Arrange on a plate with basil leaves. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Beans on Toast
instructions: Toast 2 slices of bread to a golden brown colour. 3 or 4 table spoons of beans, 1 teaspoon of butter, some black pepper in a bowl and microwave for 1 min 30 sec. Butter toast to all 4 corners, stack on top or place side by side on a plate. Mix beans when they come out of the microwave. Pour the beans on top of the toast.

title: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Preheat a pan. Add Olive Oil to the pan. crack open preferred amount of eggs into the pan. Keep stirring with a wooden spoon. Add salt & pepper along with any other seasoning you want.
